items.title: Kidd Jordan interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 24, 2006
items.q: And the first time he heard me play alto, you know what he told me? He said, “man you play like a bass player, you sound like a bass player.”

ctx.x: How much did you do with developing their ear?

I used to let them sit down and listen to me practice. I had some kids in high school used to sound like Ornette Coleman. They were — because I was playing alto then. And I was seriously — see at lunch time, when they would come to school on a bus, when they got to school in the morning they heard me standing out in front of the band room doing practicing. And at lunch times sometimes I wouldn’t eat lunch, I would practice the whole time. In the evening if they caught the bus if I had to be there for them I was…
they would do it. And some of them was playing all over the saxophone in high school too.
